info.name: SE4458 Billing API (Azure gateway)
info.description: Every billing operation through the Kong gateway on Azure Container Apps. Run the folders in order: 0 and 1 first (logins store tokens in the active environment, or in collection variables when none is selected). Folders 4 and 5 change data; reseed afterwards with `.\deploy\azure.ps1 -Step seed -Reset`. Select the "Billing - Azure" or "Billing - Local (docker compose)" environment from docs/postman/; without one, the collection defaults to Azure. The MCP server is not in this collection: use Postman's MCP request type (New > MCP, HTTP, {{mcp}}).
